description.value: Lucia is a modern Italian restaurant in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, reimagining Italian classics with a contemporary sensibility in a warmly lit, intimate setting. Located on the busy Main Street corridor, it draws diners for long, leisurely meals with an emphasis on wine and conversation. Reservations are encouraged, with a waitlist option and private dining available for larger groups.
